invoiceSent.subject: New invoice from {{operatorName}}: {{invoiceNumber}}
invoiceSent.body: {{operatorName}} has sent you an invoice for services rendered.
invoiceSent.copyAttached: A copy of the invoice is attached to this email for your records.
invoiceSent.contactInfo: If you have any questions, please contact {{operatorName}} at {{operatorEmail}}.

paymentConfirmationClient.subject: Payment confirmed for invoice {{invoiceNumber}}
paymentConfirmationClient.body: Thank you! Your payment has been successfully processed.
paymentConfirmationClient.receiptAttached: For your records, a receipt is attached to this email.
paymentConfirmationClient.contactInfo: If you have any questions, please contact {{operatorName}} at {{operatorEmail}}.

paymentConfirmationOperator.subject: Payment received for invoice {{invoiceNumber}}
paymentConfirmationOperator.bankTransfer: Your funds will be transferred to your bank account (****{{bankAccountLast4}}) within 1-3 business days.

overdueReminder.subject2: Second reminder: Invoice {{invoiceNumber}} is {{daysOverdue}} days overdue
overdueReminder.subject3: Final reminder: Invoice {{invoiceNumber}} is {{daysOverdue}} days overdue
overdueReminder.opening1: This is a friendly reminder that
overdueReminder.opening2: We understand that oversights happen, but
overdueReminder.opening3: Please take immediate action to settle this invoice as
overdueReminder.finalNotice: If payment is not received soon, {{operatorName}} may need to take further action. Please contact them at {{operatorEmail}} if you have any concerns.
overdueReminder.alreadyPaid: If you've already paid, please disregard this message. If you {{issue}}, please contact {{operatorName}} at {{operatorEmail}}.
overdueReminder.issue1: have any questions or need an extension

payoutConfirmation.subject: Payout processed: {{amount}} on its way
payoutConfirmation.body: Your payout has been successfully processed and is on its way to your bank account.
payoutConfirmation.arrivalTime: Funds typically arrive within 1-3 business days depending on your bank.

payoutFailed.subject: Action required: Payout failed
payoutFailed.body: We were unable to process your payout of {{amount}}.
payoutFailed.updatePrompt: Please update your bank account information to receive this payout. Your funds are safe and will be transferred once your account is corrected.
payoutFailed.support: If you need assistance, contact our support team at {{supportEmail}}.

connectAccountComplete.subject: Payouts enabled! You're ready to get paid
connectAccountComplete.body: Great news! Your bank account has been successfully connected and verified. You can now receive payouts from your clients.
connectAccountComplete.autoTransfer: All future invoice payments will be automatically transferred to your bank account after fees.
